response.overview: Produced by Journal Films, "Options for Life" (1979) shows the dangers of having a lifestyle that includes poor eating habits and food selection, a non-existent exercise program, smoking, and the abuse of alcohol.  The film emphasizes the importance of personal decision-making in maintaining health and well-being. It highlights that while medical advances have dramatically reduced deaths from infectious diseases, lasting health depends largely on individual choices, including hygiene, nutrition, exercise, and lifestyle habits.
response.title: Options for Life
